channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Fourth of July with fireworks and America 250 events
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Juno Beach residents push for new fence at JB-7 beach access as town faces thousands in costs
item.description: A missing fence at a Juno Beach public beach access point is creating tension between Colony Condos residents and summer beachgoers, with a fix potentially costing the town thousands of dollars.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board is pushing back against a judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year following controversial social media .

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to win 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, and the only Florida city selected this year.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive 'A' rating from state
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an 'A' rating from the state for the third year in a row, with 143 district-operated schools rated A or B.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after insurance denial hours before reconstruction surgery
item.description: A breast cancer patient and her surgeon are speaking out after her insurance company denied coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled.

item.title: Boca Raton High School band to represent Florida at National Independence Day Parade
item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band has earned a spot in Washington, D.C.'s National Independence Day Parade, representing the entire state of Florida.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4 percent this year
item.description: A holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire days before her birthday
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed many of their belongings.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board is pushing back against a judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year following controversial social media .

item.title: Juno Beach residents want fence restored at JB-7 beach access point as trespassing complaints mount
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say people using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons. A fix could cost the town thousands of dollars.

item.title: Port St. Lucie moves forward with Midway Road expansion and Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Last month, the Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange coming to Florida's Turnpike.

item.title: Palm Beach County to consider elevated autonomous transit connecting West Palm Beach to airport
item.description: Glydways, a California-based autonomous transit company, will present a proposal to Palm Beach County commissioners Tuesday for an elevated network of self-driving vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams prepare for Fourth of July weekend boaters
item.description: Lt. Brett Harry with Martin County Maritime Response Unit said they're expecting hundreds of boaters to be on the water celebrating this weekend. His team will have two boats with medics on standby in Martin County in the north and south.
